text:
liz-b: Quick sync: CloudOne launch is T+7. We need final decisions on measurement dimension (compute-ms vs tokens vs inference-requests), trial-credit handling, and dispute flow before we publish the marketplace listing.

raj: I'll take measurement. note: CloudOne will send compute in ms and memory-seconds for HW SKUs. We should avoid opaque conversions in public docs.

mica: Proposal: add "usage_dimension" enum to payload with values ["tokens","compute_ms","memory_ms","requests"]. In ingestion we attach conversion_profile_id if partner requests token-equivalent mapping.

partners-bot: New doc: https://confluence.internal/marketplace/partners/cloudone-dimensions (examples + signing keys). :link:

nina-billing: For trials: recommend we represent trial credits as an entitlement event: entitlement_type=trial, entitlement_amount=USD or units, entitlement_valid_until. That way billing/export can filter them out or apply priority.

paul-integrations: Agreed. Also: include partner_txn_id & partner_sequence for ordering. Webhook header X-Partner-Signature required. We'll also accept batched arrays for hourly windows.

raj: How do we handle rounding? CloudOne reports compute_ms with decimals. We should document rounding rules: store raw as reported_units_decimal, billable_units rounded_down_to_integer per SKU rounding policy.

sam-sysops: Ingest notes: we'll store both raw_reported (decimal string) and normalized_integer. Backfill policy: 45 days for marketplace (longer than usual ops) but adjustments beyond 30 days need partner ops review.

billing-bot: Automated note: daily_reconcile job runs 03:00 UTC, exports /exports/marketplace/daily/YYYY-MM-DD.csv.gz with columns: usage_window_start, usage_window_end, partner_id, sku_id, reported_units, billable_units, adjustment_flag, approval_id.

nina-billing: For credits: negative adjustments that net >$5,000 require finance approval. Please add approval_id to adjustment events.

paul-integrations: Sample outbound reconciliation payload (partners can pull):

```
{
  "date":"2026-03-22",
  "partner_id":"cloudone",
  "rows":[
    {"sku":"cloudone-ai-small","reported_units":"12345.67","billable_units":"12345","unit_type":"tokens","entitlement_id":"ent-xyz"}
  ]
}
```

raj: For dispute flow: partner posts /marketplace/dispute with partner_txn_id, disputed_rows[], reason_code. System creates dispute ticket with status OPEN, attaches original report and reconciliation diff. SLA: respond within 72 hours.

maria-legal: Add contract clause: partners have 60 days from export availability to raise disputes for a given billing period; after that we treat exports as final except for fraud or clerical errors.

liz-b: Action items: raj -> PR for payload schema + conversion profiles; paul -> webhook idempotency + batched support; nina -> entitlement trial export handling; sam -> update backfill TTL to 45 days in ops runbook; maria -> contract clause draft; billing -> add approval threshold note in finance runbook. Aim EOD Wednesday.

partners-bot: FYI deploy queued: marketplace-api v3.2 (idempotency fixes)

liz-b: Thanks all. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly. :pray:
